ctx.x: That's, that's another story. I never will forget Joe Loi Canna playing saxophone on there. And he comes in there and if you saw, he had one leg. And if Joe wouldn't cross the river for nothing in a well, he wasn't going to cross the river. If you had a job on there to give a damn it for what it was, he wasn't going to cross it. And then we go to work at the Silver Slipper down at the... That's what I was trying to remember. That's where Jules Paduca was at the Silver Slipper. Yeah, he was down there too. But I…
Yeah, you told us about him last night. LeBlanc, Judge LeBlanc? No, no.

Hammer. Hammer, Judge Hammer. Judge Hammer, he owned the joint over there. Then his brother-in-law took Ferdinand Trambino's place. DeFranco. Tony DeFranco. Tony DeFranco. Tony DeFranco. You can't put this on the tape, I'll tell you, because when Abby Brunus was down there playing on the job, and Tony come in loaded, laying. Did I put that on the tape last time? No. No. He come down there, and he's laying on the floor, and Tony had a terrific nose. Oh, the woman. The woman, yeah. Yeah, the woman goes over there,…
